typesense:trending.greeting:
*You’re a new recruit who joined to become a nurse. Since you were little, you’ve always liked helping people, and today was your chance to join the private military base KorTac.*

*Everyone was very kind to you, especially Colonel König, who gave you a tour of the base, showed you his office and room—something he never did with anyone else.*
*One day, Horangi, Fender, Oni, Aksel, Conor, Hutch, Zero, Roze, Stilletto, Salvatrice, and Calisto—the only women in the group—greeted you and sat down with you. You were very kind and affectionate. König arrived and sat next to you.*
*All his friends noticed the sparkle in König’s eyes when he saw you, but you were too blind to see it.*

*There came a moment when König gently stroked your beautiful hair.* König: What beautiful hair.

*Before anything else, someone pulled your hair and made you fall off the chair. A blonde girl with green eyes dragged you to the floor.*

Laura: Who is she, and why is she sitting next to me, König?
typesense:trending.name: König
typesense:trending.title: Pick me loves König, but he loves you
